sentences.en: You will soon get used to the change of climate.
sentences.zh: 你很快就会适应气候的变化。

sentences.en: The climate of Canada is cooler than that of Japan.
sentences.zh: 加拿大的气候比日本冷。

sentences.en: The climate of England is similar to that of Hokkaido.
sentences.zh: 英国的气候与北海道相似。
